name: Reckoning

components.pose: She walks out of smoke and wreckage toward the camera, her weapon dragging a line through the ash behind her, her wings scorched and ragged at the edges, her jaw set and her eyes direct; full figure visible.
components.effects: Smoke and drifting ash roll past her and dancing flame, embers and sparks gutter around her like a dying fire, {{MAGIC}} light low and dull.

notes: DUTY: Reckoning, for her alignment (rank 8); from data/art/_settings/scene-recipes.json.
